blocks.title: Terms
blocks.lead: The terms for using teleionlabs.com and Teleion Fabric, in plain words. Updated November 2, 2026.

blocks.heading: Who runs it
paragraphs: Teleion Labs Incorporated runs teleionlabs.com and Teleion Fabric.

blocks.heading: Free through December 31, 2026
paragraphs: Teleion Fabric is free to use until 11:59:59 PM Eastern on December 31, 2026, within the limits on the [Free page](/free/) and fair use.
Everything here is free to use. Nothing on these sites asks for or takes money.

blocks.heading: Fair use
paragraphs: If someone's use crowds out others or harms the service, we may slow it down or stop it.

blocks.heading: Private information
paragraphs: Don't submit private information. We don't accept private information at this stage.

You must be at least 18. Some work here runs on Meta's models. We follow Meta's terms and policies to the extent possible and may limit access at our discretion; please follow them too. See the [Meta models notice](/legal/meta-models.txt).

blocks.heading: No warranty
paragraphs: We offer these sites and Teleion Fabric as they are, with no warranty. They may change, slow down or stop, and practice work may be removed at any time.
